items.title: FDA cracks down on online black market for weight loss peptides
items.summary: The FDA's latest efforts to curb the illicit US medicines trade are primarily centred around weight loss and fat-reducing peptides.

items.title: Roche licenses Simcere’s B-cell-targeting tri-specific for $1.53bn
items.summary: The antibody is designed to provide broad coverage across B-cell mediated diseases and might have autoimmune therapeutic potential.

items.title: Peptide innovator says the drug class is due for a rethink
items.summary: Karsten Eastman, CEO of Sethera Therapeutics, discusses developments in peptides from cutting-edge innovation to mass consumption.

items.title: How to avoid common contamination control mistakes in new aseptic facilities
items.summary: As soaring biologics demand drives new aseptic facility construction, manufacturers face stricter regulatory scrutiny.

items.title: Ono Pharmaceutical joins forces with Aitia for drug discovery in neurology
items.summary: Ono Pharmaceutical has signed an agreement with US biotechnology company Aitia to collaborate on drug discovery in neurological diseases.
